verification.browser: Headless Microsoft Edge against local frontend; fixtures intercept mutation requests

Shop rejects reversed price ranges with a visible explanation
Blog search submits and returns an empty result for a missing article
Product gallery responds to arrows and Escape, share URLs use frontend origin
Known incorrect catalogue photos are withdrawn locally
Message read action updates immediately; native Cancel sends no delete
Service Active label toggles and Features preserve commas until save
Admin negative price filter is explained and variant starting price is read only
Columns popover fits short and mobile viewports and scrolls to its last control
Long wishlist names and quote text fit a 390px viewport

pint.full_repository: pre-existing failures on 20 untouched files in this Windows checkout

application.local_photo_migrations: Both applied successfully; only the four matching known image records were changed.
application.remote: Commits pushed to origin/content. No production/staging deployment or remote migration is claimed.
application.deployment_requirement: Deploy frontend and backend together and apply the two 2026_10_22 photo migrations to replace existing catalogue image records. Corrected photos are guarded from replacement.

limitations: Approved real product photos are still needed for the three Conveyor Feet listings and Steelton four-wheel set. Placeholders remove misleading images but do not supply final catalogue photography.

The PDF contains historical evidence, observations and blocked test scenarios. This work does not claim that the original complete test campaign was rerun, or that historical ambiguous deletion/payment outcomes were reconstructed.
No real payment, customer message deletion or test email was performed during regression verification.
Full-repository Pint reports formatting issues on 20 files unchanged from the starting commit. All seven PHP files changed for this task pass Pint; existing unrelated formatting was left intact.

issues.title: Services: null image crashes page
issues.resolution: Missing or blank service images use the existing fallback.
issues.verification: Source review and successful Astro compilation; live data has no active null-image fixture.

issues.title: Service Active text does not toggle
issues.resolution: The checkbox and text share a label.
issues.verification: Edge fixture: clicking Active toggles the checkbox.

issues.title: Service Features typing loses separators
issues.resolution: Keep raw text while typing and split/trim only when saving.
issues.verification: Edge fixture: sequential typing preserves commas/spaces and save sends three trimmed features.

issues.title: Selected variant specs disappear after label collision
issues.resolution: Preserve differing variant values with a selected-variant suffix on colliding labels.
issues.verification: Component test switches Steel and Aluminium and keeps their respective values plus static specs.

issues.title: Social sharing uses backend origin
issues.resolution: Use the current frontend product URL after hydration.
issues.verification: Edge verifies the Facebook share URL matches the frontend origin and product path.

issues.title: Checkout line subtotal ignores quantity
issues.resolution: Multiply normalized unit price by quantity in checkout and payment summaries.
issues.verification: Checkout component test verifies quantity two at £12.50 displays £25.00.

issues.title: Blank details and invalid UK postcode accepted
issues.resolution: Trim details, validate required fields/email/UK postcode, display field errors and guard restored payment data.
issues.verification: 15 validation cases cover whitespace, valid/invalid postcode, business and separate billing fields.

issues.title: Stale cart stock lets checkout continue without explanation
issues.resolution: Refresh current product price/availability and explain blocked items before checkout/payment.
issues.verification: Cart tests cover stock zero, changed price, missing product and network failure; Edge confirms blocked checkout.

issues.title: Admin accepts negative price filters silently
issues.resolution: Explain invalid negative/nonfinite/reversed ranges; do not apply invalid filters.
issues.verification: Shared range tests and Edge negative-price fixture.

issues.title: Primary price appears to reset after variant save
issues.resolution: Show the minimum variant price as read-only Starting price with an explanation.
issues.verification: Edge fixture confirms minimum 12.50 and read-only field; backend product tests pass.

issues.title: Columns popover extends outside viewport
issues.resolution: Constrain the whole popover to available viewport height/width and allow scrolling.
issues.verification: Edge checks 1280x650 and 390x650 with 16 columns; last control remains reachable.

issues.title: Gallery keyboard navigation is missing
issues.resolution: Arrow keys switch images; Escape closes; focus stays inside and returns to the opener.
issues.verification: Focus hook tests and Edge arrow/Escape/focus checks.

issues.title: Long quote content overflows
issues.resolution: Allow flex children to shrink and long strings to wrap.
issues.verification: Edge fixture with 500-character uninterrupted description/response has zero horizontal overflow at 390px.

issues.title: Historical social sharing origin issue
issues.resolution: Covered by BUG-CONT-005; not counted twice.
issues.verification: See BUG-CONT-005.

issues.title: Checkout and product option labels are disconnected
issues.resolution: Associate checkout field labels and dynamic product selection labels with unique input IDs.
issues.verification: Checkout component tests access fields by label; Astro type check passes.

issues.title: Icon-only quantity/remove actions lack names
issues.resolution: Add accessible names to basket and product quantity/removal buttons.
issues.verification: Source review and successful type check/build.

issues.title: Wishlist button overflows beside a long product title
issues.resolution: Let the title shrink and wrap while reserving button width.
issues.verification: Edge long-title fixture keeps the button within its row with no page overflow at 390/1024/1280px.

issues.title: Public pages lack main headings
issues.resolution: Add H1 to affected list/account/cart/checkout pages and use H1 for portfolio detail.
issues.verification: Edge confirms one main H1 on six affected routes and portfolio detail.

issues.title: Portfolio detail columns overflow
issues.resolution: Use fractional grid tracks that account for the gap and shrinkable content.
issues.verification: Edge confirms no horizontal overflow at 1024/1280px.

issues.title: Blog search is inert
issues.resolution: Submit a GET search form and preserve the query with filtering/pagination.
issues.verification: Edge submits a missing article query and confirms its URL, input value and empty result.

issues.title: Cookie page title is inconsistent
issues.resolution: Normalize default cookie titles to Cookie Policy throughout the page.
issues.verification: Edge confirms the document title and H1.

issues.title: Reversed Shop price range has no explanation
issues.resolution: Show a visible range error and do not confuse invalid input with a valid empty result.
issues.verification: Range tests plus Edge reversed-range check.

issues.title: Category introduction extends beyond its container
issues.resolution: Use fractional grid tracks instead of percentages plus a gap.
issues.verification: Public Stainless Steel Sheets category reproduced 8px overflow at both 1024/1280px; after fix 0px, title right edge equals grid edge. Admin form had no overflow and was not the source.

issues.title: Conveyor Feet show unrelated sheet photos
issues.resolution: Withdraw known wrong main/gallery images for three products and show a neutral unavailable-photo placeholder.
issues.verification: Migration test protects approved/unrelated images; local API and Edge confirm placeholder. User does not know approved photo locations.

issues.title: Steelton four-wheel set photo shows an incomplete set
issues.resolution: Withdraw the known mismatched set photos and show the same unavailable-photo placeholder.
issues.verification: Migration test plus local API verification. An approved photo showing the actual four-wheel set is still required.

issues.title: Header search keyboard close/focus behavior
issues.resolution: Use a named dialog with Escape, focus containment and focus restoration.
issues.verification: Edge keyboard test passes after hydration.

issues.title: Information sidebar keyboard focus escapes
issues.resolution: Use a named dialog with Escape, focus containment and focus restoration.
issues.verification: Edge tabs repeatedly through the dialog and verifies focus restoration.

issues.title: Category Active text does not toggle
issues.resolution: Wrap checkbox and text in a label.
issues.verification: Edge fixture confirms the text toggles the checkbox.

issues.title: Mark Read remains after first opening
issues.resolution: Update selected message and list using current state after mark-read succeeds.
issues.verification: Edge mock response confirms Mark Read disappears immediately.

issues.title: Delete cancellation previously had an ambiguous outcome
issues.resolution: Native confirm cancellation exits before sending DELETE; no application change required.
issues.verification: Edge controlled fixture explicitly dismisses confirm, observes zero DELETE requests and retains the record. Historical data loss is neither established nor disproved by this check.

issues.title: Checkout draft overwritten on return from payment
issues.resolution: Restore the draft before customer prefill and persist the business choice.
issues.verification: Component tests cover already-loaded customer plus restored draft, and late customer loading after typing.

issues.title: Older order disappears after the sixteenth order
issues.resolution: Add pagination and server-side search/status filters; group search OR conditions and order ties by ID.
issues.verification: Frontend tests cover next-page, global search, combined filters and retry. Backend tests cover 16 orders and search/status intersection. No new real payment was made.

issues.title: Renaming a product changes its public URL
issues.resolution: Keep the existing slug when editing the name.
issues.verification: Authenticated backend test renames the product then retrieves it through its original public URL. Previously changed unknown URLs are not reconstructed.

issues.title: Variant stock zero blocks buying when product tracking is off
issues.resolution: Retain existing explicit variant-stock priority; product-level tracking only controls fallback stock.
issues.verification: Existing stock unit tests and backend suite pass. No new stock policy was invented.

issues.title: Initial Mangal search was inconsistent
issues.resolution: Current GET search consistently filters the catalogue.
issues.verification: Edge repeats first-entry/Enter search from fresh Shop loads three times, getting one Mangal result; missing query returns zero. Historical initial conditions remain unknown.
